title: C drops Content-Format on all OSCORE-protected responses; Rust emits it when cf != 0 — wire divergence (49e460a2 residual)
description: Reviewer finding (worker2, bead yiv0 correctness pass). C's protected branch of coap_oscore_respond_resource (coap_oscore.c:138-144) calls coap_oscore_protect_response, whose signature (coap_oscore.h:214) has NO content_format parameter — C silently drops it, so C never emits Content-Format on ANY OSCORE-protected response (including the accepted-claim 2.04 where CBOR_CONTENT_FORMAT is passed and vanishes). Rust (lichen-gateway) still emits [0xc1,60] for nonzero cf on protected responses (e.g. accept arm CoapResponse::changed cf=60, resources.rs:2243; GET responses with CONTENT_FORMAT_CBOR). 49e460a2 fixed only the cf=0 case (correct as scoped). Remaining gap is undocumented in code, and C ignoring its own parameter looks like a C-side bug. DIRECTION NEEDS DECISION: (a) Rust always-omits CF on protected responses (match C as-is), or (b) fix C to emit CF on protected responses (coap_oscore_protect_response signature change). Also note: record_own_claim_envelope has no production caller (only test resources.rs:3238), so runtime 4.09s always take the empty-payload fallback at resources.rs:2155 — the spec/08:315 winning-claim payload is never sent until l1qw.20 lands. C always echoes (claim_store_cose). Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-yiv0.
close_reason: Direction (b) landed: C now carries Content-Format as a Class E inner option on OSCORE-protected responses, byte-identical to Rust gateway.rs encode_content_format_option (0 omits; <=255 -> 0xc1 + 1B BE; else 0xc2 + 2B BE). coap_oscore_protect_response gained options/options_len forwarded to oscore_protect_response; coap_oscore_respond_resource encodes cf and passes it; 8 call sites updated (keys/msg/server/waypoints/retries/test). New ztest test_protected_response_carries_content_format asserts inner dopts == {0xc1,0x3c} through the real respond->protect->socket->unprotect path; cf=0 roundtrip now asserts dopts_len==0. Suite coap_oscore_fallback: 7/7 PASS on native_sim/native/64 (v4.1.0). Review findings: (1) helper moved inside CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE ifdef (unused-function, fixed); (2) pre-existing pt_len underflow in oscore_protect.c:632-638 filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-kx28 (oscore edit bar, for Mark); (3) stale authorize_mutating stubs breaking msg_sent/msg_ack/waypoints suites commented onto project-LICHEN-worker6-2z8e. Also fixed in passing: fallback suite was unrunnable on v4.1.0 (NET_TEST=y excludes net drivers -> no loopback for the socket capture); prj.conf now sets NET_DRIVERS=y so the existing NET_LOOPBACK=y works (valid on CI's v3.7.0 too), and its stale lichen_coap_respond test double collided with the real coap_respond.c since the respond-split - double removed, suite now exercises the real implementation. Commit 97396e874a.
